new_results.statement: For C_*=sup s3(A)||p_Q||inf and ell(u)=exp(-|u|)/2, C_*=sup s3(A) max_y E ell(Q-y). At every global Laplace mode y_*, the exponentially weighted masses to the right and left are exactly equal and each equals the kernel height. Hence C_* equals the supremum of either one-sided exponential contribution over Laplace modes, with zero constant loss.

For tau(u)=(1-|u|)_+, C_*=sup s3(A) max_y E tau(Q-y). At every global tent mode y_*, P(y_*-1<Q<y_*)=P(y_*<Q<y_*+1). If B_* is the supremum of s3(A) times either adjacent unit-window mass over tent modes, then B_*<=C_*<=2B_*.
Applying account04/B15 heat-height plus scalar homogeneity gives equality of the optimal sharp constant C_* with the fixed unit Gaussian, unit Laplace, and unit tent positive-kernel functionals.
